# Micah 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Woe to-those-planning iniquity and-working evil upon their-beds! In-the-light-of the-morning they-do-it, for it-is in-the-power-of their-hand.

**2** And-they-covet fields and-seize-[them], and-houses and-take-[them]; and-they-oppress a-man and-his-house, a-man and-his-inheritance.

**3** Therefore, thus says YHWH: "Behold-Me planning against this family evil from-which you-will-not-remove your-necks, and-you-will-not-walk haughtily, for it [will be] a-time-of evil.

**4** In-that day one-will-take-up against-you a-taunt and-will-wail a-wailing-of woe [and]-say, 'We-are-utterly-ruined! The-portion-of my-people he-exchanges! How he-removes-[it] from-me! To-the-apostate he-divides our-fields!'

**5** Therefore you-will-have no-one casting the-line by-lot in-the-assembly-of YHWH."

**6** "Do-not-preach!" they-preach. "They-should-not-preach about-these-things; reproaches will-not-depart!"

**7** Should-it-be-said, O-house-of Jacob, "Is-the-Spirit-of YHWH impatient? Are-these His-deeds?" Do-not My-words do-good to-the-one-walking uprightly?

**8** But-recently My-people rise-up as-an-enemy; from-the-front-of [the]-garment you-strip the-cloak from-those-passing-by securely, [those]-returning from-war.

**9** The-women-of My-people you-drive-out from-the-house-of her-delight; from-her-young-children you-take My-glory forever.

**10** Arise and-go, for this [is]-not your-resting-place, because-of uncleanness that-destroys, and-[the]-destruction [is]-grievous.

**11** If a-man walking in-wind and-falsehood has-lied, [saying], 'I-will-preach to-you of-wine and-of-strong-drink' — he would-be the-preacher for-this people!

**12** "I-will-surely-gather all-of-you, Jacob; I-will-surely-assemble the-remnant-of Israel. Together I-will-set-them like-sheep-of Bozrah, like-a-flock in-the-midst-of its-pasture — they-will-be-noisy from-[the]-multitude-of people."

**13** The-breaker goes-up before-them; they-break-through and-pass the-gate and-go-out through-it; and-their-king passes before-them, and-YHWH at-their-head.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **2:1-2**: Choveshim aven — 'those planning iniquity.' The nighttime scheming followed by dawn execution mirrors the anti-creation pattern: darkness breeds evil carried out in light.

- **2:6**: Al-tattiphu yattiphun — 'Do not preach! they preach.' Ironic: the people try to silence prophetic speech using the very verb (natap, 'to drip/preach') they reject. The prophet-silencers are themselves preaching.

- **2:12-13**: Sudden shift from judgment to restoration. The 'breaker' (ha-porets) who goes before the flock is a messianic figure — the one who breaks through barriers to lead the remnant home.

— EMET
